Kuwait Residency and Visit Visa Fine Calculator

Choose the violation and enter the residence or visit expiry date and your exit or settlement date to see the fine by tier.

Calculate the fine

Fines under Kuwait's Residency Law 114/2024

ViolationArticleDaily fineMaximum
Residence expired or renewal refused, and not leaving132 in the first month, then 41,200
Domestic workers132600
Residence not obtained after entry92 then 4 (domestic 2)1,200 (domestic 600)
Temporary residence or departure notice exceeded122 then 41,200
Visit or entry visa exceeded11102,000
Leaving a job, then a new residence granted17, 18 and 202 then 41,200
Newborn registered after 4 months62 in the first month, then 42,000

Amounts are in Kuwaiti dinars and are settlement fines paid to close the violation. The decree-law took effect on 5 January 2025 and its executive regulations on 23 December 2025, with no change to the amounts. Related fees: temporary residence KD 10 a month (KD 5 for domestic workers) and a departure notice KD 10 a month.

Examples:
Residence expired on 1 August 2026, leaving on 15 October (75 days): 30 × 2 + 45 × 4 = KD 240.
A domestic worker in the same case: 75 × 2 = KD 150.
Visit visa expired on 1 August, leaving on 15 October: 75 × 10 = KD 750.
The residence fine reaches its KD 1,200 cap on day 315, and the visit fine its KD 2,000 cap on day 200.

We assume the "first month" is 30 days starting the day after the residence expires, and no grace period is published. If the violator does not settle by paying, the case is referred and deportation is possible. To work out what you are owed when leaving a job, use the Kuwait indemnity calculator.

Frequently asked questions

What is the fine for an expired residence in Kuwait?

KD 2 for each day in the first month, then KD 4, up to KD 1,200, under Article 13 of Decree-Law 114/2024, in force since 5 January 2025. The fine is a settlement: paying it ends the violation.

What is the fine for overstaying a visit visa in Kuwait?

KD 10 for each day up to KD 2,000 (Article 11), with no grace period after the visit ends.

What is the residence fine for domestic workers?

KD 2 for each day up to KD 600, without the increase to KD 4 after the first month.

When must a newborn be registered?

Within 4 months of birth. After that, KD 2 a day in the first month then KD 4, up to KD 2,000, according to press reports citing the Ministry of Interior; one source reported KD 2 a day without tiers.

What happens if the fine is not paid?

The fines are settlements. If the violator does not settle by paying, the case is referred and the person may be deported by order of the Minister of Interior, with deportation costs borne by the sponsor or employer.

Did the new executive regulations change the fines?

The executive regulations of the residency law took effect on 23 December 2025, and the settlement amounts did not change from the list announced in January 2025.
